elevator_pitch: A through-hole-friendly adjustable boost converter built around the LM2596-ADJ, converting 3 V–12 V inputs to a regulated higher output — designed for panel-mount integration with screw terminals and indicator LEDs.
description:
The LM2596 is typically used as a step-down (buck) converter, but in this design it is configured as a step-up (boost) topology using a modified Ćuk-adjacent switching arrangement. The board accepts input voltages from 3 V to 12 V and boosts to user-selected outputs between 5 V and 35 V via a precision multi-turn trimmer potentiometer in the feedback divider.

Despite being a boost converter, the LM2596 provides internal current limiting and thermal shutdown — essential safety features for bench and field use. A Schottky catch diode (SS54) handles the boost rectification with minimal forward-voltage loss. The output filter consists of a 220 µF electrolytic capacitor with a parallel 100 nF ceramic for high-frequency decoupling.

Screw terminal blocks on the input and output allow the board to be wired into existing panel-mount assemblies without soldering to a PCB. A dual-color LED (red = power, green = output regulation status) provides visual feedback. Board dimensions fit a standard 2U rack-mount panel cutout, and M3 mounting holes allow chassis attachment.
